sloka: उत्सृज्य प्रमदाम् एनाम् अनपेक्षौ यथा आगतम् ।त्वरमाणौ पलायेथाम् न वाम् जीवितम् आददे ॥३-३-७॥
transliteration: utsṛjya pramadām enām anapekṣau yathā āgatam ।tvaramāṇau palāyethām na vām jīvitam ādade ॥3-3-7॥

translations.english: By the grace of Lord Brahma I was bestowed with this prowess through my penance. In this world none can kill me with a weapon nor split nor cut me to pieces.
